points.description: States the core procedure: pop elements off the stack (checking each against the target) and hold them in another/temporary stack until the element is found, then push the removed elements back onto the original stack.
points.partial_credit: Award 2-3 marks if only half is given, e.g. popping elements until the target is found (without saving them or restoring them), or mentions using a second stack without restoring the original.

rubric.notes: Full marks for stating, in any wording, that you pop elements (storing them in a second stack) until the element is found and then push them back to the original stack. Part marks (about 2-3) if only one half is given, such as popping until found, or using a temporary stack without restoring. Zero for answers unrelated to popping/searching via stack operations; extra remarks do not cost marks.
